newsitem.title: THAILAND: Asia Securities shrs resume near limit up.
newsitem.headline: Asia Securities shrs resume near limit up.

text.p: Shares of Thai broker Asia Securities Trading Plc rose near their daily limit after trade was allowed to resume in the stock late on Thursday amid heavy demand.
But traders said a lack of sellers reduced supply.
The shares had gained 2.25 baht, or 9.38 percent, to 26.25 baht with five lots traded by 0830 GMT. The composite SET Index had shed 18.27 points, or 3.14 percent, to 553.35.
Shares of Asia Securities were suspended at the company's request on Wednesday morning at 24 baht.
Asia Securities Trading received a tender offer from ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett (Holdings) Limited on Wednesday offering 35 baht per share for up to 63 million shares, or 49 percent of the company.
